hero_subtitle: Every public item is labeled Verified, Declared, or Unverified with proof or disclosure.
m1_lead: Official domains are shown with their latest build-time trust status. This is not runtime monitoring.
m1_outside_lead: Domains in the roadmap that could not be probed in Phase 1. Not presented as Verified.
m1_note: Probe method: DNS lookup + HTTP HEAD. Phase 1 does not assert content correctness.
m2_lead: Phase 1 publishes high-level team responsibility boundaries only. Private ownership conflicts and internal operator details stay out of public mode.
m2_data_title: Team fields required before public display
m2_d3: Status, public contact reference, owner declaration, disclosure, and last reviewed date.
m2_unverified_lead: Team items are Declared until the public contact reference, owner declaration, and review date are approved.
m3_lead: Official public channels must show scope, use case, status, public evidence, disclosure, and last reviewed date.
m3_u3: Public status, support, or reporting path.
m3_n4: Internal telemetry that could aid abuse.
m3_h4: Disclosure when public proof is incomplete.
m3_footer: Phase 1 exposes only public-safe channel details.
m4_lead: Verification methods explain what is checked, what evidence applies, and what limitations remain.
m4_c1: DNS resolution is checked at build time.
m4_c2: HTTP status is checked at build time.
m4_c3: Content correctness is not asserted in Phase 1.
m4_c4: Internal-only evidence downgrades public claims to Declared.
m4_c5: Missing or stale proof downgrades public claims to Unverified.
m4_note: Methods without public proof must not be described as fully verified.
m5_lead: Short links require a slug, destination, owner scope, status, public reason, evidence reference, disclosure, and last reviewed date.
m5_note: Ambiguous, stale, or unowned short links must be Declared or Unverified.
m6_lead: Phase 1 provides visible paths for mismatch, stale claim, and impersonation reports.
m6_empty_title: No public incident list is published in this module
m6_empty_body: This module is for reporting paths in the active foundation pack. Public incidents remain tracked by the incident process and must not be invented.
m6_note: The page must not overpromise response time or enforcement capability in Phase 1.
m7_lead: Public trust pages may be created only when disclosure, visibility, status, stale, and evidence rules are preserved.
m7_fallback: Use this path for mismatch, stale claim, impersonation, or builder output issues. If the form fails, use the email fallback below.
m7_f4: Last reviewed date and trust status.
m7_future_note: Generated or builder-assisted pages must not bypass claim status, evidence, disclosure, stale, or visibility rules.
footer_disclosure_en: This page may be AI-assisted and human-reviewed. Build evidence is available in the verification log.
